overview_description.description:
Abstra is a software development platform that provides businesses with a low-code platform. Its platform facilitates the creation of internal tools and apps, through a graphical interface and offers solutions to operational problems helping businesses to get personalized applications to make their internal processes more efficient. It is focused on late-/growth-stage tech companies and enterprise IT consulting companies. So far, Abstra is growing MRR (monthly recurring revenue) by 45% on average and has landed 11 customers, including Accenture, Stone, and Descomplica.

The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

about_short_description.short_description: Abstra is a software development platform that provides businesses with a no-coding platform.

product.name: Abstra AI Workflows Platform
product.description: A platform enabling finance teams to design, deploy, and monitor automated workflows without developer support, using drag-and-drop and AI templates.

product.name: Abstra Editor
product.description: A local development environment for building and testing automation workflows using Python, available on Windows, macOS, Linux, and web.

product.name: Abstra Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based console for hosting, monitoring, and managing production automation workflows built with Abstra Editor.

product.name: Human-in-the-Loop Automation with Dynamic Forms
product.description: A solution that integrates dynamic, customizable forms into automated workflows to enable real-time human interaction and validation.

product.name: Finance Operations Automation Suite
product.description: A comprehensive set of AI-powered automation tools covering invoice processing, reporting, reconciliation, and financial planning tasks.

product.name: Credit Analysis Automation
product.description: An AI-driven system for automating credit decisions, risk scoring, and compliance reporting in financial institutions.
